papers.title_en: Look Before You Restore: Learning to Predict Before Acting for Agentic Image Restoration
papers.authors: Xu Zhang, Jun Wan, Lefei Zhang, Liangpei Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向混合退化图像修复的智能体框架
papers.tldr: 混合退化图像复原智能体通常先执行工具再评估效果，失败调用浪费算力，有害输出也难以及时发现。PreActIR 为每个候选工具引入条件世界模型，在执行前预测退化、质量与保真度变化及风险不确定性，并由独立验证器决定提交或回滚。在固定候选池、验证器与预算的受控评测中，真实工具调用减少42.5%，被拒调用减少63.4%，Y-PSNR提升0.92 dB。该工作把“先执行后评估”转为“先预测后执行”。
papers.abstract_en: Agents for mixed-degradation image restoration typically learn what a tool does to an image only after running it: failed calls waste computation and harmful outputs go unnoticed until too late. We propose PreActIR, an agentic restoration framework that predicts tool consequences before execution. For each candidate tool, a tool-conditioned world model forecasts changes in residual degradation, image quality, and fidelity, together with the risk of harm and the uncertainty of the prediction. The agent executes the top-ranked candidate, and an independent verifier commits or rolls back its output before the agent replans from the observed state. PreActIR also audits whether performance is limited by the selector or by the candidate space, and studies targeted tool adaptation as a controlled way to expand that space. In a controlled evaluation that fixes the candidate pool, verifier, and budget and employs reference-annotated degradation states, PreActIR uses 42.5% fewer real tool calls and 63.4% fewer rejected calls than reactive, execute-then-evaluate trial and error, while improving Y-PSNR by 0.92 dB.

papers.title_en: PreciseEdit: Strong Yet Stable Semantic Transport for One-Step Image Editing
papers.authors: Jingyi Wang, Xiao Lu
papers.evidence: 一步图像编辑的精确稳定语义传输
papers.tldr: 现有单步图像编辑通过条件预测间的简单向量运算构建全局传输场，语义驱动力强，却容易沿不可靠方向溢出到非编辑区域，造成结构失真和背景漂移。PreciseEdit 从语义强度与传输稳定性的张力出发，提出模型无关、免训练、免反演的单步编辑框架。其双噪声尺度角色分解用高噪声尺度生成强目标传输，用低噪声尺度探测方向一致性与空间结构。在 PIE-Bench 上取得最优性能，兼顾目标语义对齐、背景保真和结构一致性。
papers.abstract_en: Recent one-step text-to-image (T2I) models enable efficient image synthesis, opening up new possibilities for interactive Web-based image editing. However, existing one-step editing methods often construct a global transport field through simple vector operations between conditional predictions. While such strong transport can effectively drive the image toward the target semantics, it may be released along unreliable directions or over non-edited regions, leading to structural distortions within the editing region and background drift elsewhere. More importantly, stabilizing the editing process through global smoothing or uniformly weakening the transport field often makes large semantic changes overly conservative. In this work, we revisit one-step image editing from the perspective of the tension between semantic strength and transport stability, and identify a key insight: strong semantic transport is not inherently unstable. What matters is whether it is applied along reliable directions and at reliable spatial locations. Motivated by this insight, we introduce PreciseEdit, a model-agnostic, training-free and inversion-free one-step editing framework that strengthens target-semantic alignment while preserving background fidelity and structural consistency. We further propose a dual-noise-scale role decomposition strategy: a higher-noise scale produces the strong target-directed transport used for actual editing, whereas a lower-noise scale jointly serves as a probe for directional agreement and spatial structure. Extensive experiments on PIE-Bench demonstrate that PreciseEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance and effectiveness on various editing tasks.

papers.title_en: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
papers.authors: Houyuan Chen, Fanzhou Wang, Xiangyu Fan, Zesong Qiu, Yukun Wei, Songlin Yang, Zhitao Yang, Lvmin Zhang, Pei Yang, Hao Zhao, Lei Yang, Anyi Rao
papers.evidence: 基于自回归扩散的多轮图像编辑
papers.tldr: 多轮图像编辑在连续指令下易出现视觉质量下降与内容漂移。本文提出 MT Forcing 训练范式，基于自回归扩散统一多模态模型，用单轮分布匹配蒸馏与教师强制引导联合监督。实验表明该方法显著提升多轮编辑稳定性与跨轮一致性。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, enabling more effective interactive visual content creation for users. However, existing methods often exhibit noticeable drift after only a few editing turns, manifesting in two aspects: 1) unstable visual quality, with accumulating artifacts and degraded details; and 2) inconsistent image content, with unintended changes to preserved regions and prior edits. To address these challenges, we propose MT Forcing, a novel training paradigm for multi-turn image editing with unified multimodal models (UMMs) based on autoregressive diffusion. Specifically, we propose Single-Turn Distribution Matching Distillation (Single-Turn DMD), which supervises student self-rollouts with a teacher that applies cumulative edits to the source image in a single turn, providing visual-quality guidance without recursive error accumulation. Additionally, we introduce Teacher-Forcing Guidance, which supervises history-dependent transitions on reference trajectories during warmup and as a regularizer during distillation, encouraging cross-turn content consistency beyond what per-turn distribution matching alone can ensure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the multi-turn image editing capabilities of UMMs, yielding more stable visual quality and stronger cross-turn consistency.

papers.title_en: Hihaze: One-Step Diffusion for High-Resolution Real-World Image Dehazing
papers.authors: Zheng Chen, Yuchen Huang, Xiaoyang Liu, Jue Gong, Linghe Kong, Yulun Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向高分辨率真实去雾的一步扩散框架
papers.tldr: 针对高分辨率真实图像去雾中空间非均匀雾霾和局部块预测不一致的问题，Hihaze提出单步扩散框架。它用注意力跳连补偿ASC选择性传递可靠编码特征，并用空间退化适配器SDA注入多尺度退化表示引导U-Net复原。无需训练的全局引导块融合GPF进一步对齐块外观并补偿细节。在四个真实基准上，它兼顾视觉质量与推理速度，Dense-Haze和NH-HAZE的PSNR分别提升3.62 dB和3.69 dB。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have recently achieved encouraging results in real-world image dehazing. However, restoring high-resolution images remains challenging due to spatially non-uniform haze and inconsistent predictions across local patches. To address these issues, we propose Hihaze, a one-step diffusion framework for high-resolution real-world dehazing. Hihaze adopts two haze-aware modulation modules: attentive skip compensation (ASC) and a spatial degradation adapter (SDA). ASC selectively transfers reliable encoder information to the variational autoencoder (VAE) decoder, preserving structural details while suppressing haze-degraded features. SDA extracts multi-scale spatial degradation representations and injects them into the U-Net to guide restoration according to local haze variations. Furthermore, we design a training-free global-guided patch fusion (GPF) method. It uses a global prediction to align patch appearance and downweight unreliable predictions, followed by structure-guided detail compensation. Notably, this training-free design also makes GPF a plug-and-play module for other dehazing models. Experiments across four real-world benchmarks show that Hihaze surpasses state-of-the-art approaches in both visual quality and inference speed. Specifically, it delivers PSNR improvements of 3.62~dB on Dense-Haze and 3.69~dB on NH-HAZE compared with the strongest baselines. Code: https://github.com/zhengchen1999/Hihaze.

papers.title_en: HP-PnP-Flow: Hybrid Time Scheduling and Projection for Plug-and-Play Image Restoration via Flow Matching
papers.authors: Yong Li, Xiaojie Wang, Xiaoyan Zhang
papers.evidence: 流匹配驱动的即插即用图像恢复
papers.tldr: 图像复原是典型逆问题，PnP 框架可灵活接入预训练去噪器，而 flow matching 提供连续时间 ODE 生成建模。本文在 PnP-Flow 基础上引入混合时间调度与像素空间投影算子，提出 HP-PnP-Flow，并在温和假设下给出严格收敛保证。实验表明其在 CelebA 与 AFHQ-Cat 的去噪、去模糊、超分及修复任务上显著优于 PnP-Flow。尤其去模糊和超分仅需 100 次迭代即可达到相当或更优质量，大幅提升效率。
papers.abstract_en: Image restoration is a fundamental inverse problem that seeks to recover high-quality images from degraded observations. Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods provide a flexible framework for integrating pretrained denoisers into iterative reconstruction, whereas flow matching offers an efficient generative modeling approach based on continuous-time ODE dynamics. Very recently, Martin et al.\ (ICLR, 2025) developed a PnP-Flow method, which integrates the PnP framework with flow matching through a time-dependent denoiser constructed from a pretrained flow matching model.By incorporating a different time schedule and an additional pixel-space projection operator, this paper proposes a novel efficient PnP-Flow algorithm (HP-PnP-Flow) that enjoys rigorous convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, without imposing restrictive conditions on iterates required by the aforementioned work. Numerical experiments on CelebA and AFHQ-Cat demonstrate that the newly proposed HP-PnP-Flow algorithm significantly outperforms PnP-Flow on several restoration tasks such as denoising, deblurring, super-resolution, random inpainting, and box inpainting. Notably, our algorithm achieves comparable or better reconstruction quality with substantially fewer iterations, reducing the iteration count from $500$ to $100$ for deblurring and super-resolution on AFHQ-Cat.

papers.title_en: VitronEdit: Universal Visual Editing across Images, Videos, and 3D Scenes
papers.authors: Jing Wang, Yanlin Li, Mong-Li Lee, Wynne Hsu, Shengqiong Wu, Hao Fei
papers.evidence: 跨图像视频与3D场景的通用视觉编辑
papers.tldr: 统一视觉编辑已能整合图像与视频，但3D场景编辑仍受配对数据稀缺制约。VitronEdit采用共享序列表示与渐进式多模态训练，把图像、视频中的编辑知识迁移到3D，并引入几何感知后训练，用预训练几何重建模型提供深度与相机位姿监督。实验表明，仅对3D样本施加几何监督反而取得最佳整体效果，图像和视频编辑也同步提升，说明几何正则可经共享主干迁移。该工作为数据稀缺的3D编辑提供了通用框架，并揭示了跨模态编辑知识与多视图一致性的迁移规律。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in unified visual editing have begun to consolidate image and video editing within a single model, while 3D scene editing remains largely separate and constrained by scarce paired training data. Given the rich image and video editing supervision now available and the common editing semantics shared across modalities, a natural question is whether this knowledge can be transferred to data-scarce 3D editing. We present VitronEdit, a universal framework for image, video, and 3D scene editing. VitronEdit adopts a shared sequence representation and progressive multimodal training to transfer editing knowledge across modalities. We further introduce geometry-aware post-training, which leverages a pretrained geometry reconstruction model to provide depth and camera-pose supervision. Surprisingly, applying geometric supervision only to 3D samples yields the best overall performance, while image and video editing also improve despite receiving no direct geometric supervision, suggesting that geometric regularization transfers through the shared backbone. Our analysis further shows that image and video training mainly transfers editing semantics to 3D, whereas 3D supervision primarily improves multi-view consistency. The project page: https://vitron-llm.github.io/VitronEdit/.

papers.title_en: PixelSR: Pixel-Space Orthogonal Flow Decoupling for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
papers.authors: Xiang Lv, Kai Zhao, Qiang Wang, Qiao Mo, Chao Zhou, Mingwen Shao
papers.evidence: 基于扩散的像素空间真实世界图像超分辨率
papers.tldr: 真实图像超分中的潜扩散模型长期存在保真度与真实感的跷跷板效应。PixelSR 提出单阶段像素扩散 Transformer，直接在 RGB 空间建模，并用正交流解耦把非对称流目标拆成低秩语义与无噪纹理两路分支。实验表明其在多个基准上兼顾感知细节与结构保真，有效缓解该效应。
papers.abstract_en: Latent diffusion models have recently achieved remarkable progress in Real-world Image Super-Resolution (Real-SR). However, existing methods consistently exhibit a persistent seesaw effect: enhancing perceptual realism compromises structural fidelity. This effect, we argue, is not intrinsic to diffusion models, but largely stems from the architectural constraints of prevailing two-stage frameworks. To address this challenge, we propose PixelSR, a novel single-stage Pixel Diffusion Transformer for Real-SR that operates directly in pixel space. Specifically, PixelSR consists of two core designs: Pixel-space Conditional Diffusion and Orthogonal Flow Decoupling. The former establishes an effective pixel-space restoration framework by integrating spatially aligned LR conditioning, visual semantic guidance, and lightweight texture refinement, thereby bypassing VAE compression and enabling end-to-end optimization directly in RGB space. Complementarily, the latter decomposes the asymmetric flow target into a low-rank semantic component and a noise-free orthogonal texture component. By routing these components to specialized branches, it achieves decoupled optimization with reduced mutual interference. Benefiting from these designs, our PixelSR restores perceptually realistic details while faithfully preserving structural content. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that PixelSR not only achieves competitive performance, but also effectively mitigates the fidelity--realism seesaw effect.

papers.title_en: WorldSR: Harnessing World Knowledge Search for Grounded Image Super-Resolution
papers.authors: Junyuan Deng, Xinyi Wu, Zhenyao Wu, Song Wang, Yu Wang, Congchao Zhu
papers.evidence: 结合外部世界知识的生成式图像超分辨率
papers.tldr: 生成先验超分依赖大模型隐式知识，但随机性强且易幻觉，难以满足高保真重建。WorldSR将输入分解为语义实体，从外部大规模图像库检索实体级视觉世界知识，并用记忆机制与多步过滤提升效率可靠性。检索结果经多参考超分模型融合，为细节合成和结构恢复提供细粒度约束。真实场景基准上结构保真与视觉质量稳定提升，优于现有生成式超分方法。
papers.abstract_en: Generative-prior-based super-resolution (SR) methods leverage implicit knowledge learned from large-scale models to enhance low-resolution inputs. However, such priors are inherently stochastic and optimized for diverse generation, conflicting with the deterministic, high-fidelity reconstruction required for SR. It is also tied to the base model, costly to update, and prone to hallucinations as real-world data evolves. To address these limitations, we introduce WorldSR, a novel framework that augments SR with explicit, entity-aligned visual world knowledge. WorldSR automatically decomposes the input into semantic entities and performs entity-wise retrieval of structurally and semantically aligned images from a large-scale external corpus. For efficiency and reliability, we incorporate a memory mechanism to reuse previously retrieved results and a multi-step filtering process to refine candidate references. The selected references as world knowledge are then integrated through a novel multi-reference super-resolution model, which provides fine-grained constraints for detail synthesis and structural recovery. Experiments on real-world SR benchmarks show that WorldSR consistently improves structural fidelity and visual quality, outperforming existing generative super-resolution methods. Our results suggest that entity-level grounding in external visual world knowledge provides a simple and effective complement to model-bound generative priors.

papers.title_en: WaFIR: Wavelet-Fourier Mixture-of-Experts with Subband-Adaptive Routing for Blind All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.authors: Trong Nhan Nguyen, Vu Hoang Minh Doan, Thanh Dat Le, Truong Tien Vo, Thi Thu Ha Vu, Tan Hung Vo, Jaeyeop Choi, Junghwan Oh, Truong-Son Hy
papers.evidence: 小波傅里叶混合专家实现盲全合一图像恢复
papers.tldr: 盲一体化图像复原需在无任务标签下适应异构乃至混合退化。WaFIR 将特征分解为 Haar 子带，用紧凑傅里叶描述子表征各子带，并路由至提示条件的光谱调制专家，实现子带级频率特异处理。在去噪、去雨、去雾统一协议下，其平均 PSNR 较 PromptIR 提升 0.48 dB、较 Up-Restorer 提升 0.38 dB，且容量与路由对照表明增益非仅来自参数增加。该工作把子带频率结构作为可解释补充，增强盲复原的鲁棒性与路由可分析性。
papers.abstract_en: Blind all-in-one image restoration must adapt a shared model to heterogeneous and sometimes mixed degradations without a task label at test time. We introduce WaFIR, a decoder module that decomposes features into Haar subbands, summarizes each subband with a compact Fourier descriptor, and routes it to prompt-conditioned spectral modulation experts. Unlike image-level frequency conditioning, WaFIR makes routing decisions at the subband level, enabling frequency-specific processing while retaining the task context learned by the backbone. Under a unified training and evaluation protocol for denoising, deraining, and dehazing, WaFIR improves average PSNR over the three tasks by 0.48 dB over the PromptIR baseline and by 0.38 dB over the recent Up-Restorer. Matched-capacity and routing controls show that the gain is not explained by additional parameters alone. On unseen noise intensities, descriptor-based routing is more robust than a discrete label-conditioned alternative and remains on par under compound degradations, while routing analyses show stable subband-dependent expert use across degradation types. These results support subband frequency structure as an interpretable complement to prompt-based conditioning for blind image restoration. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WaFIR/README.md

papers.title_en: ER-Chord: Spatially Consistent One-Step Image Editing via Equal-Energy Reliability Redistribution
papers.authors: Peize Li, Hanzhen Zhao, Xingguo Xu, Yilong Fan, Zhen Tao, Bo Yin, Zhifei Liu, Qingdong He, Xiaobin Hu
papers.evidence: 一步式扩散图像编辑与空间一致性控制
papers.tldr: 一步生成模型虽能快速完成文本引导图像编辑，却常误改应保持不变的区域；现有时间聚合只稳定跨噪声层编辑场，未按局部可靠性分配空间编辑强度。ER-Chord提出免训练、免反演框架，以相邻噪声层编辑场一致性作为局部可靠性信号，通过等能量优化重分配控制能量并保持原编辑方向与总能量。该方法无需额外去噪调用即可求得唯一全局解，在PIE-Bench和TEdBench上优于现有一编辑基线，并提升源图像保持性。
papers.abstract_en: One-step generative models enable fast text-guided image editing, yet they often introduce unintended changes to regions that should remain unchanged. Temporal aggregation stabilizes editing fields across noise levels, but leaves their spatial allocation insensitive to local variations in reliability. Consequently, temporal stability alone does not ensure spatially consistent editing. To address this lim- itation, we propose ER-Chord, a training-free and inversion-free framework for reliability-guided spatial redistribution. Our key insight is that agreement between editing fields at neighboring noise levels provides a local reliability signal for allocating editing strength. We formulate this allocation as an equal-energy op- timization that redistributes control energy according to local reliability while preserving the original editing directions and total control energy. This formu- lation admits a unique global solution that can be efficiently computed using existing field evaluations, requiring no additional denoiser calls. Experiments on two benchmarks, PIE-Bench and TEdBench, demonstrate improvements over state-of-the-art one-step editing baselines, achieving superior source preservation alongside consistent gains across multiple generative backbones.The project page is at https://github.com/Peizeli1/ER-Chord.

papers.title_en: BluePixel: Toward Native 4K Agentic Image Editing
papers.authors: Shanyan Guan, Shiyu Li, Xin Li, Zhizhou Chen, Yunzhe Xu, Yuehao Liu, Ruixue Shen, Shiju Zhang, Min Jin, Qiang Liu, Junbo Liu, Penggang Shi, Sheng Sun, Xiao Wang, Yong Zhang, Zhongang Qi, Wei Li, Chao Ma, Ying Tai, Yanhao Ge
papers.evidence: 指令驱动的原生4K智能体图像编辑
papers.tldr: 指令驱动的图像编辑已迈入原生4K，但训练配方始终未公开，从零预训练对多数团队不可行，且单一端到端模型难以精确调参或理解模糊指令。BluePixel将原生4K编辑模型与智能体框架结合：用渐进式VAE适配把1K预训练编辑器升级为4K，经持续学习吸收长尾垂直技能，再用强化学习平衡美学与保真，并以SATP蒸馏把50步压缩到4步。单张昆仑芯P800上完成一次4K编辑仅需8.7秒，同时保持任务成功率与背景一致性。在VINS-4KEval++上，BluePixel在七个模型中排名第二，非编辑区域一致性仅次于GPT Image 2，并完整公开训练方案。
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-driven image editing has reached native 4K, yet how such editors are trained remains undisclosed, and pretraining one from scratch is beyond most teams. The task itself compounds the difficulty: a single end-to-end editor cannot make precise parametric adjustments, match specialized experts, or interpret the vague instructions users actually write. We argue that 4K editing is a system problem rather than a single-model problem, and present BluePixel, which couples a native-4K editing model with an agent harness; the complete training recipe is disclosed in this paper. The model makes 4K training practical: it turns a 1K-pretrained editor into a native-4K one through progressive VAE adaptation that keeps 4K training as affordable as 1K, absorbs a long tail of vertical editing skills through continual learning, and refines the aesthetic-fidelity trade-off with reinforcement learning. Distillation via source-anchored target projection (SATP) then compresses 50 denoising steps to 4, completing a 4K edit in 8.7 s on a single Kunlunxin P800 XPU while preserving task success rate and background consistency. The harness, BluePixel Agent, makes editing controllable: it decomposes user instructions into specialist and general operations, verifies every result with the same reward model that guided training, and retries within bounded attempts. On VINS-4KEval++ (3,305 native-4K cases), BluePixel ranks second among seven models, behind only GPT Image 2 in non-edited-region consistency.

papers.title_en: UltraDiff: Transferring High-Fidelity Priors to Compressed Latent Spaces for High-Resolution Image Generation
papers.authors: Jingjing Ren, Haitian Zheng, Haoyu Chen, Connelly Barnes, Zhifei Zhang, Yuqian Zhou, Zhe Lin, Lei Zhu
papers.evidence: 潜空间扩散实现高分辨率图像生成
papers.tldr: 高分辨率 latent diffusion 存在计算成本与生成保真度的根本权衡，压缩因子 f32 虽显著提效却带来严重信息损失与歧义。UltraDiff 将挑战重构为联合 latent diffusion 学习与边缘分数蒸馏，提出 MixTeacher 双分支 DiT 联合建模 f8-f32 分布，并通过共享注意力用高保真 f8 先验消解 f32 压缩空间歧义。方法关键是在原生 f32 空间进行向量场蒸馏，理论上迫使学生学习教师轨迹的条件期望，从而过滤压缩伪影。在 1K 到 4K 设置下，UltraDiff 接近 f8 质量并保持 f32 效率，单张 A100 用 20 步生成 2K 图仅 6.2 秒，比 f8 基线快 40 倍以上。
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) faces a fundamental trade-off between computational cost and generative fidelity. This trade off is largely governed by the latent compression factor f (e.g. f8 denotes f=8 and f32 f=32). While aggressive compression (f32) significantly improves efficiency, it suffers from severe information loss and ambiguity compared to standard f8 models. We propose UltraDiff, a framework that reformulates this challenge as joint latent diffusion learning followed by marginal score distillation. We introduce MixTeacher, a dual branch DiT that models the joint f8-f32 distribution, utilizing shared attention to resolve the ambiguity of the compressed space with high fidelity f8 priors. Crucially, we propose vector field distillation in the native f32 space. Theoretically, this compels the student to learn the conditional expectation of the teacher trajectory, effectively filtering out compression artifacts. Across the evaluated 1K to 4K settings, UltraDiff approaches f8 level quality while preserving f32 efficiency. With 20 sampling steps on a single A100 GPU, it generates a 2K image in 6.2 seconds over 40 times faster than our f8 baseline.

papers.title_en: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance for TI2I Flow Matching
papers.authors: Andreas Floros, Elena Koritska, Teofilo de Campos, Christoph Vogel, Chu-Tak Li, Anuj Sharma, Alexandros Neophytou
papers.evidence: 面向可控图像编辑的无分类器引导
papers.tldr: 本文研究文本-图像到图像（TI2I）流匹配的可控图像编辑，重新审视CFG在其中的作用。作者发现CFG在流建模的高噪声阶段会隐式损害编辑，削弱指令遵循与可控性。为此，他们在早期流步骤引入一种简单校正，在不增加额外成本的情况下改善对齐与内容保留的权衡。该方法在像素空间和潜空间TI2I流上均验证有效，为TI2I中的CFG机制提供了新理解与实用改进。
papers.abstract_en: We study Text-and-Image-to-Image (TI2I) flow matching methods for controllable image editing. In a broader generative modeling context, Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is established as a key component responsible for high quality outputs. However, we argue that its role in TI2I modeling is poorly understood. Specifically, we make the surprising observation that the CFG mechanism is implicitly harmful for editing in the noisy phase of flow modeling, hindering instruction following and controllability. We propose a simple correction in the early flow steps, enabling a richer alignment-preservation tradeoff at no extra cost. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated on both pixel-space and latent TI2I flows.

papers.title_en: Beyond Pairwise Repulsion: Collective Diversity via Determinant Maximization in Diffusion Sampling
papers.authors: Kwanyoung Lee, SeungJu Cha, Yebin Ahn, Sungho Koh, Dong-Jin Kim
papers.evidence: 面向文生图扩散模型的多样性采样
papers.tldr: 文本到图像扩散模型在强引导下会把独立噪声映射到近乎相同的视觉原型，批内多样性不足，影响合成数据增强。DetNO 将多样生成建模为初始噪声上的 RKHS 体积最大化，用一步 Tweedie 预测的 RBF Gram 矩阵对数行列式作为集合级目标，并以锚点保真项和单一 λ 平衡质量。它在 SD1.5、SDXL、SD3 上取得领先的 VendiScore 与平均自相似度，少样本合成数据增强分类准确率显著提升。该目标无需训练或改采样器，且随批量增大相对 InfoNCE 的多样性优势更明显。
papers.abstract_en: Strong guidance in text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models concentrates sampling toward high-density modes of the conditional distribution, collapsing independently sampled noise vectors onto nearly identical visual prototypes. This limits utility for tasks that demand distributional breadth, most critically synthetic data augmentation. Diversity, however, is a collective property of the whole batch: a set can preserve every pairwise distance yet still collapse onto a low-dimensional subspace. Existing sum-of-pairwise noise-optimization and repulsion objectives respond only weakly to this higher-order failure. We propose DetNO (Determinant Noise Optimization), which formulates diverse generation as RKHS volume maximization on the initial noise, maximizing the log-determinant of an RBF Gram matrix over one-step Tweedie predictions. This set-level functional equals the squared batch volume; its repulsion is strongest when the batch is most collapsed and self-attenuates as diversity is achieved. An anchor-based fidelity term keeps the optimized noises near plausible regions, and Lagrangian relaxation gives a two-term objective with a single hyperparameter $λ$ governing the diversity-quality trade-off, without training or sampler modification. Across three backbones (SD1.5, SDXL, SD3), DetNO achieves leading intra-batch diversity in VendiScore and Mean Self-Similarity, and a downstream few-shot classification experiment confirms that broader mode coverage brings statistically significant accuracy gains for synthetic data augmentation in the low-shot regime. Fixing the pipeline and varying only the batch objective, both RBF-based aggregators outperform InfoNCE, and the log-determinant attains the best downstream accuracy on both benchmarks. Its diversity advantage over InfoNCE widens as the batch grows. Code is available at https://github.com/mobled37/DetNO.

papers.title_en: From Global to Tail Convergence: Dynamics of $α$-Stable Score-Based Generative Models
papers.authors: Ianis Hammani, Claire Boyer
papers.evidence: α稳定分数生成模型的非渐近收敛分析
papers.tldr: α-stable Lévy分数生成模型经验有效但理论不足。本文对保尺度α-stable生成动力学做非渐近p-Wasserstein分析，覆盖紧支撑与幂律目标，量化早停、初始化、分数近似和离散化误差，并证初始化误差指数衰减。与布朗动力学相比，全局收敛不区分二者，但尾部清晰分离：稳定动力学具指数α幂律尾，布朗为轻尾；目标尾指数ν时仅α=ν可正确刻画极端分位数。由此确立尾指数匹配为捕捉极端事件的关键机制。
papers.abstract_en: Score-based generative models driven by $α$-stable L{é}vy processes have been proposed as an alternative to Brownian diffusion models, with empirical evidence suggesting improved sampling and better modeling of heavy-tailed data. Yet theoretical guarantees for these models remain limited. We develop a non-asymptotic convergence analysis for scale-preserving $α$-stable generative dynamics, covering both compactly supported and power-law targets. In p-Wasserstein distance, we quantify the effects of early stopping, initialization, score approximation, and time discretization, and show exponential decay of the initialization error. A comparison with Brownian dynamics reveals that global Wasserstein convergence alone does not fundamentally distinguish the two models: both initialization errors decay exponentially with the forward horizon on the common class of heavy-tailed targets. A sharp separation emerges instead in the tails. At any positive generation time, stable dynamics produces power-law tails with index $α$, whereas Brownian dynamics remains light-tailed. For a target with tail index $ν$, asymptotically correct extreme-quantile scaling is possible precisely when $α$=$ν$. These results identify tail-index matching as a principled mechanism behind the ability of stable generative models to capture extreme events.

papers.title_en: Are We Overthinking One-Step Generation?
papers.authors: Woobin Park, Jaeyeon Kim, Yilun Du, Sitan Chen, Bohyung Han
papers.evidence: 面向单步扩散与流生成的简单两阶段框架
papers.tldr: 扩散与流匹配通常需多次网络评估，一步生成虽受关注但训练机制复杂。Priming Models 采用两阶段框架：先在固定噪声水平做像素空间重建，再进行特征空间分布后训练。作者发现重建阶段已足以消除分布训练的困难，在 ImageNet 256×256 上以约十分之一训练计算取得一步生成器中最优 FID 1.19。该工作简化了一步生成训练流程，并显著推进训练计算与生成质量的帕累托前沿。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow matching are now dominant frameworks for generative modeling in continuous domains, but they typically require multiple network evaluations at inference. This has motivated extensive research on one-step generative modeling primarily built on diffusion and flow, though existing approaches often rely on complex training machinery. In this work, we introduce Priming Models, a simple two-stage framework for training one-step generators. Motivated by the difficulty of distributional training from scratch, Priming Models are first trained on a reconstruction objective, e.g., pixel-space denoising at a fixed noise level, before undergoing feature-space distributional post-training. Our central scientific finding is that this simple reconstruction stage is already enough to entirely alleviate the difficulty of distributional training. Empirically, across class-conditional image generation, text-to-image generation, and world modeling, Priming Models significantly advance the Pareto frontier of training compute vs. generation quality. On ImageNet at $256 \times 256$ resolution, we achieve a state-of-the-art FID of $1.19$ among one-step generators using approximately one-tenth the training compute of prior methods with comparable FID. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/JaeyeonKim01/priming.

papers.title_en: Purify Before You Align: Improving Representation Alignment for Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Yingheng Wang, Yaoqiang Li, Yaqin Wu, Junwen Bai, Jiatao Gu, Christopher De Sa, Volodymyr Kuleshov
papers.evidence: 通过改进表征对齐目标优化扩散训练
papers.tldr: 表征对齐可加速扩散训练，但标准对齐未区分预训练特征中对生成有用的信息。作者提出局部外观净化LAP，先去除局部可预测内容，再对齐残差，且不改训练与推理。在五种编码器上提升生成质量，MAE最显著，SiT-B/2上ImageNet-256 FID从53.1降至42.3。贡献在于揭示对齐效果取决于目标强调的信息，并给出可预测收益的检验。
papers.abstract_en: Representation alignment improves and accelerates diffusion training by encouraging intermediate features to match a pretrained visual encoder. However, standard alignment matches pretrained representations without distinguishing what information may be more useful for generation. We introduce local appearance purification (LAP), which improves generation quality and makes encoders such as MAE more effective alignment targets by removing locally predictable content and aligning to the residual. LAP modifies only the alignment target, and requires no changes to diffusion training or inference. Through controlled interventions within a fixed encoder, we show that effective alignment depends on what information the target emphasizes, not simply how much image information it contains. Our theory gives a variational interpretation of standard alignment and, for fixed local predictors, a sum of token-wise information bounds conditioned on local appearance. To understand why purification benefits some encoders more than others, we derive an exact constant-readout test that measures how well the target can be matched without using the diffusion model's hidden state. LAP improves generation quality across five pretrained representations (MAE, AIMv2, CLIP, DINOv2, DINOv3), with the largest gain for MAE: on ImageNet-256 with SiT-B/2, it reduces FID from $53.1$ to $42.3$. Its gains persist with stronger alignment recipes and tokenizers. Computed before diffusion training, the constant-readout score predicts the benefit of purification (Spearman $ρ=0.94$ across 13 encoders).

papers.title_en: Intern Lumina U2: A Multi-Codebook Diffusion Large Language Model for Omni-Visual Understanding and Image Generation
papers.authors: Qian Yu, Zongyang Qiu, Juncheng Yan, Hongliang Li, Qi Qin, Keqi Wang, Siqi Luo, Junkui Ju, Yapeng Mi, Tiantian Lu, Tian Liu, Pengyu Xie, Chenhao Ji, Minghui Zhang, Yiang Zhao, Siyu Yan, Haiying Xu, Yanbo Wang, Jianghan Shen, Yuandong Pu, Jiayi Lei, Borui Zhang, Jinxin Shi, Bo Zhang, Yuhang Zang, Shenglong Ye, Lixin Gu, Hongjie Zhang, Linghan Liu, Xinyuan Chen, Yuewen Cao, Lihe Zhang, Xiaohong Liu, Junjun He, Qiangwei Liu, Qi Zhang, Yu Cheng, Tianfan Xue, Hui Xiong, Chang Xu, Yu Qiao, Yihao Liu, Bin Fu
papers.evidence: 多码本扩散大语言模型用于图像生成
papers.tldr: 统一多模态生成面临单码本离散表征容量不足、连续与混合范式空间异构易冲突的问题。Intern Lumina U2 以扩散语言模型在全离散空间表示多码本视觉token：每位置拼接多码本嵌入，轻量自回归头逐码预测，扩散骨干并行处理所有位置。基于AToken统一4D表示覆盖图像、视频与3D，在视觉理解、图像生成和编辑上领先，并以稳定性感知采样将图像生成加速4.45倍。
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal generation covers discrete, continuous, and hybrid paradigms. Discrete approaches with single-codebook visual tokenizers align naturally with text modeling but have limited representational capacity. Continuous and hybrid approaches retain richer visual representations, but they model text and images in heterogeneous spaces with different training objectives, potentially introducing optimization conflicts between modalities with misaligned representation spaces. These choices expose a central question: how to efficiently model high-capacity visual representations alongside textual content in a shared optimization space within a single backbone. We present Intern Lumina U2, to our knowledge the first diffusion language model to represent multi-codebook visual tokens in a fully discrete space. Each visual position is represented by a group of codes from complementary codebooks, increasing its representational capacity while preserving compatibility with discrete text modeling. At the input, the embeddings are concatenated at each position; at the output, a lightweight multi-codebook autoregressive head predicts the codes within each position sequentially, while the diffusion backbone processes all positions in parallel. Built on the unified 4D representation of AToken, Intern Lumina U2 supports image, video, and 3D inputs within a single backbone and achieves leading performance among unified models in visual understanding, image generation, and image editing. We further build a full-stack training, inference, and evaluation system on both Ascend and NVIDIA platforms to verify the cross-platform effectiveness of our model. We also improve the inference efficiency through a stability-aware sampling strategy, which combines confidence-plateau-guided unmasking approach with drift-triggered cache refreshing mechanisms, accelerating image generation by 4.45x.

papers.title_en: Discriminative Score Function: Turning Pretrained Models into Functional Generative Priors
papers.authors: Junhoo Lee, Hyeonjin Kim, Sangbum Han, Nojun Kwak
papers.evidence: 从预训练判别模型提取生成场作为生成先验
papers.tldr: 判别模型虽仅按分类、检测或表征学习目标训练，却可能隐含数据流形信息。本文提出判别分数函数DSF，从预训练判别模型的损失梯度几何中提取图像空间生成场，无需重训练或任务标签即可迭代更新图像。DSF在ResNet、DETR、DINOv2上实现无条件生成，并支持条件引导、编辑、修复与解释。其生成样本还可用于零样本量化校准，优于无数据基线，表明判别训练保留了可用的生成信号。
papers.abstract_en: Discriminative models are trained with task-specific objectives such as classification, detection, or representation learning, yet their practical utility depends on generalizing beyond the training task to unseen samples from the same domain. This suggests that a discriminative model may retain an implicit trace of the data manifold beyond its task labels. We ask whether this trace can be exposed as a generative signal without task-specific guidance. We introduce the Discriminative Score Function (DSF), which extracts an image-space generative field from the loss-gradient geometry of a pretrained discriminative model. DSF provides a training-free update rule that moves images toward model-consistent visual regions without retraining or task-specific targets. We apply DSF to diverse pretrained discriminative models, including ResNet classifiers, DETR detectors, and DINOv2 ViT encoders. DSF generates unconditional images from noise and supports conditional guidance, editing, inpainting, and explanation through the same field. DSF-generated samples also provide effective zero-shot quantization calibration when real images or labels are unavailable, preserving feature geometry better than data-free calibration baselines. These results show that discriminative training leaves a generative functional signal for synthesis and calibration. Project page: https://junhoo.me/dsf.

papers.title_en: Mixed Poisson diffusion models and application to posterior sampling
papers.authors: Thibaut Pellerin, Alain Durmus, Elinor Berger, Eric Barat
papers.evidence: 基于泊松噪声的扩散模型及其逆问题后验采样
papers.tldr: 扩散模型擅长学习复杂分布，但连续数据常用高斯加噪，难以直接匹配泊松逆问题中离散计数观测的生成机制。本文提出混合泊松扩散模型（MPDM），用多元计数过程刻画前向加噪动力学，并据此建立泊松逆问题的后验采样框架。作者进一步推导了多种基于该模型的采样算法，并在真实泊松逆问题上验证其适用性。结果表明，该框架能自然处理离散泊松观测，为泊松逆问题提供了新的生成式先验与后验采样途径。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are a powerful framework for learning complex probability distributions. While widely used diffusion models for continuous data rely on Gaussian noising processes, we instead develop diffusion models based on Poisson noise. More precisely, we introduce and study a new mathematical framework, called Mixed Poisson Diffusion Models (MPDM), with noising dynamics driven by multivariate counting processes.   Our methodology is motivated by Poisson inverse problems. The success of Gaussian diffusion models has led to their use as prior models in a growing number of posterior sampling methods for inverse problems. However, most of these approaches focus on Gaussian inverse problems, in which observations are generated through a deterministic forward operator corrupted by additive Gaussian noise. By contrast, Poisson inverse problems, where observations are discrete and Poisson distributed, remain comparatively underexplored in this literature. Building on our Poisson generative dynamics, we develop a natural framework for posterior sampling in Poisson inverse problems and derive several posterior sampling algorithms based on the proposed model. We evaluate our approach on realistic Poisson inverse problems and show that the resulting framework is well suited to this class of problems.

papers.title_en: From Semantic Editing Intentions to Persistent Parametric Controls for AI-Assisted Image Editing
papers.authors: Rifat Mehreen Amin, Michelle Dutoit, Anton Rockenstein, Baptiste Caramiaux, Andreas Butz
papers.evidence: 带参数化控制的AI辅助语义图像编辑
papers.tldr: AI图像编辑中，用户高层编辑意图如何转化为具体操作常不透明。作者提出Atelier，依据图像语义与用户意图生成可直接操控的上下文相关控件，并让用户继续细化而非直接采纳AI结果。12名实践者的组内研究显示，用户偏好这种AI组合控件，认为其支持探索并会主动调整，但对控制感和解释性的体验不一。研究表明，可操控控件能让AI解释可行动，却不足以让所有用户理解其依据。
papers.abstract_en: AI-powered image editing increasingly allows users to express high-level editing intentions, yet how these intentions are translated into concrete editing actions often remains difficult to understand. We present Atelier, a semantic image editing tool that uses image semantics and user intent to determine which editing controls to surface and how to initialize them. Guided by a formative study with eight image-editing practitioners, Atelier composes context-specific, directly manipulable controls that users can refine rather than committing AI interpretations directly to finished edits. In a within-subjects study with 12 practitioners, participants preferred AI-composed controls, described them as supporting creative exploration, and actively refined AI proposals. However, experiences of control were mixed, and interviews highlighted limited insight into why particular controls and values were proposed. Our findings suggest that making AI interpretations actionable through manipulable controls can support exploration and refinement, but actionability alone does not make those interpretations transparent to all users.
